editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood Indian spot that delivers genuine comfort food with fresh naan, generous portions, and kind service.
editorial.insiderTip: The lunch buffet is no longer available, but the Chef's Special lunch (weekdays $9/person, weekend pricing higher) remains a great value with multiple dishes—call ahead or ask your server about current pricing and specials.
signatureDishes: Chicken Tikka Masala with Garlic Naan
